item.title: Ellett Memorial Hospital asks for your help
item.description: From the desk of EMH CEO, Laura SmithHow you can help us. Ellett Memorial Hospital and the Appleton City Rural Health Clinic aren't just places you go when you're sick - they're part of who we are as a community. The people who work here are your neighbors, friends, and sometimes even family. Our staff have deep roots in this town, and they care about you because they live here too. They show up every day with pride, compassion, and a genuine commitment to keeping high-quality care close to home

item.title: Missing Harrisonville man found deceased
item.description: We want to provide an update on our post from last week regarding the deceased person found in the creek by Sutherland's. Today, the medical examiner confirmed the person to be Daniel Potter of Harrisonville, MO. At this time, no foul play is suspected and this appears to be a tragic accident. We have spoken to Daniel's family directly to express our sympathy and condolences during this difficult time. We ask that this community do the same and show them the love and support they need right now.

item.title: Alternative methods deer harvest results in Missouri
item.description: Missouri hunters harvested 13,063 deer during the alternative methods portion of firearms deer season, Dec. 27 through Jan. 6. Top harvest counties: Callaway with 284 deer harvested, Pike with 283, and Franklin with 271. Share your harvest pics! More harvest data at extra.mdc.mo.gov/widgets/harvest_table/. Last year, hunters checked 10,083 deer during the portion. More harvest data from past years at http://mdc.mo.gov/.../deer-harvest.../deer-harvest-summaries.

item.title: Kocurek found guilty following 2 days of testimony in sex crimes case
item.description: Shortly before 2 pm this afternoon, Senior Judge James Journey found Michael Andrew Kocurek, beyond a reasonable doubt, guilty on 2 counts of Sodomy in the First Degree and 2 counts of First degree child endangerment. In 2017 Kocurek was charged with 1st Degree Sodomy, 1 Count of 1st degree statutory rape, and 2 counts of 1st degree child endangerment. item.description: December 31, 2025 The Bates County Commission met with Presiding Commissioner Jim Wheatley, Northern Commissioner John Gray and Southern Commissioner Trent Nelson present.Linda Evans came in and spoke to the Commission about a property line issue with the City of Drexel.Dane Diehl stopped by and caught up with the Commissioners and answered any questions and concerns they may have had.
